entries.9e5be27e015db8d3: The majority of revenue comes from domestic operations, and the core of the strategy is growth at existing domestic stores and new store openings. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, the company opened 28 new stores in Japan and made a group operating the Megane Super business a subsidiary, which broadened the base for store operations under both store brands. Overseas operations are run on a franchise model and account for a small share of revenue.

entries.bda0e676ff0d92e5: Established in 1993, it is a group consisting of the company and nine consolidated subsidiaries. It has 3,347 employees and is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.be2196ff73078d25: A reportable segment that sells eyeglasses and other products in Japan; its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥49,253 million.
entries.c0cc7736b3580594: Its mission is 'Creating an era in which eyeglasses take center stage,' and it aims for a society in which people change their eyeglasses every day, as they do T-shirts. Under its vision of 'Eye Performance,' it aims to become a brand needed by society and daily life, presenting eyeglasses not only as vision-correcting devices but also as fashion items and tools that extend human potential, offering new value. Its management strategy calls for efforts to raise sales at existing stores, expand the sunglasses market, open stores strategically, accelerate DX and EC operations, improve store operating efficiency, and strengthen internal control systems.
entries.c95a5a9cc85cc7e2: Profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥4,119 million.
entries.ca497034d32ff6c6: The overall domestic eyewear market recovered from a temporary decline caused by the spread of infectious diseases to its pre-outbreak size and has been flat over the medium to long term. Within this, the low-price eyewear market to which the Zoff Business belongs is growing faster than the overall market, and the company explains that it is expanding its share. The majority of revenue comes from domestic operations (¥49,253 million), and no counterparty accounts for 10% or more of revenue in the information by major customer.
entries.ccbde4161dd7c524: Its strength lies in having two businesses with different sales structures. The Zoff Business handles everything from planning to sales under the SPA model, allowing customer information to be reflected in planning immediately, and it can keep prices down because no wholesalers are involved. The Megane Super Business has strengths in selling high-value-added eyewear products and contact lenses based on attentive customer service, and the combination meets different customer needs.
